questions.question: On which date is Gandhi Jayanti celebrated every year?

questions.question: Which famous Saka ruler’s inscription is engraved on a boulder at Girnar or Junagadh?

By facilitating efficient movement of goods and services, leading to growth

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (By facilitating efficient movement of goods and services, leading to growth) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (single transferable vote) है।
